checks.title: Goal Owner
checks.instructions: Agree on the customer outcome and source, decision and action owners. Produce a sourced opportunity, an owner-accepted priority decision, and testable requirements with open questions and no automatic issue write.

checks.title: Subject Scope
checks.instructions: Bind exact tenant and subject IDs. One product, customer segment, opportunity and strategy horizon; preserve participant privacy and the current roadmap revision.

checks.title: Source Policy
checks.instructions: Agree on data access, version and source-of-truth policy. Use authorized research, current opportunity and roadmap records, an approved strategy goal, and current design or behavior evidence.

checks.title: Decision Rule
checks.instructions: Record the blocking decision rule and evidence gaps. Discovery is evidence, Product priority needs explicit owner acceptance, and requirements stay a draft until Product, Design and Engineering review.

checks.title: Team Bindings
checks.instructions: Inspect the named Crew templates and existing compatible Crews. Record exact Crew IDs, skill versions and grants; propose creation only for a missing owner or access boundary.

checks.title: Source Access
checks.instructions: Read at least one real authorized first-stage record and the current downstream source. Record source IDs, observed times, permissions, missing fields and owner.

checks.title: Handoff Contract
checks.instructions: Run scripts/validate_handoff.py on each stage artifact. Block wrong tenant, subject, source revision, producer, approval or route-specific claim. The typed sequence is product-opportunity-brief/v1 → product-priority-decision/v1 → product-requirements-brief/v1.

checks.title: Plan Review
checks.instructions: Show the concrete Crew bindings, artifact paths, validator steps, manual route, approvals, deduplication, cost and notifications. No participant contact, roadmap edit, issue write, delivery date or customer promise follows from installation or a draft.

checks.title: Test Run
checks.instructions: Use one real authorized opportunity with a counterexample, current roadmap and an owner decision; retain an accepted or blocked outcome. Save real source references, artifacts, validation and owner corrections. Fictional examples cannot complete this check.

checks.title: Activation Choice
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. Any event or schedule needs exact subject and deduplication keys, permissions, retry limits, cost and notification review. Keep all consequential actions behind separate approval and provider receipts.
